annotation.evidence_span: MUST send only one header block
annotation.interpretation_a: Only one header block is allowed in the trailers section, even if it's empty.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only one non-empty header block is allowed in the trailers section; an empty header block is permissible.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'one header block' is open to interpretation. Does it mean 'at least one non-empty header block', or 'exactly one header block, which may be empty'? The difference affects implementation, as a receiver might need to handle the case of an empty trailer block differently.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether an empty header block is considered 'one header block'. This affects how receivers handle zero-length trailer blocks.
